# DTCG 2025.10 JSON Schema snapshots

Vendored from the stable, versioned Design Tokens Community Group schema endpoints:

- https://www.designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10/format.json
- https://www.designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10/resolver.json

These files are committed so BeeUI conformance tests run without network access. `SHA256SUMS` records the exact downloaded bytes. Runtime token behavior does not depend on these files.
